findings.comment: Buildings' maintenance of minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. While site plan layout suggests buildings are positioned away from overhead line routing at property edges, no surveyed conductor elevations or dimensioned clearance measurements from building facades to outside conductors are provided on the plans.

Customer facilities' maintenance of minimum 15-foot radial clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors cannot be verified. No plan views or section views show dimensioned measurements from outside conductors in all directions (radial clearance envelope) to buildings, transformers, or other installations.

applicableAreas: Building overhangs, awnings, balconies, and roof projections
findings.comment: Building projections' (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) maintenance of required clearances from overhead electric conductors cannot be verified. No building elevation or section views are provided that show the extent of projections and their clearances from overhead conductors. Site plan shows buildings but detailed architectural elevations with projection information are not included in the electrical review documents.

applicableAreas: Building footprints, site perimeter near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are not provided. The site plan shows overhead electric lines at the property edges (Valley View Road frontage and eastern boundary), but no building elevation drawings are included in the plan set demonstrating surveyed conductor locations and measured clearances to building facades, rooflines, or projections.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8, site plan and section views
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings or building projections for clearance verification. While overhead electric lines are depicted on the site plan, no dimensioned clearance annotations are provided showing distances measured from the outside conductor to building edges.

Fences' maintenance of minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor of overhead electric facilities cannot be verified. Site plan shows fences at property perimeter, but no clearance dimension annotations from conductors to fence locations are provided.

applicableAreas: Proposed fences at or near existing electric poles
findings.comment: Fence posts' maintenance of minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from overhead electric poles cannot be verified. Poles are shown at property edges along Valley View Road frontage and eastern boundary, but no dimension annotations show clearances from proposed fence post locations to pole centerlines.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls around site perimeter and detention pond
findings.comment: Retaining walls' maintenance of minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outermost electric line cannot be verified. Sheet 38 shows wall plan and locations, but dimension annotations from conductors to wall faces are not provided.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls around site perimeter and detention pond
findings.comment: Retaining wall section exhibits lack dimension annotations from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of walls for clearance verification. Sheets 38 and 39 show wall details and sections, but no dimensions showing clearances from surveyed overhead conductor locations to wall faces are provided.

Driveways do not show documented minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot vertical clearance (areas with truck traffic) from lowest point of overhead electric facilities. No surveyed mid-span clearance data or registered surveyor documentation is provided showing conductor heights above proposed driveway grades.

applicableAreas: Vehicle parking areas on concrete pads
findings.comment: Vertical clearance from vehicles parked or displayed on concrete pads to lowest overhead electric lines cannot be verified, and no requirement note is shown on site plans. Parking areas are shown on site plan, but no section views document minimum vertical clearance (12 feet for residential pedestrian areas, 16 feet for parking without trucks, 18 feet with truck traffic) from overhead lines.

applicableAreas: Entire site plan, areas with overhead electric line routing
findings.comment: Clearance dimensions are not provided on plans with sufficient clarity to verify whether they are measured from utility pole centerline or from the outside conductor. While overhead electric lines are shown on sheets, no dimension lines with annotations are visible indicating the measurement origin point (conductor vs. pole centerline). Without dimensioned clearances from identified outside conductors, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings and site features in electric easement areas
findings.comment: Customer facilities within electric easement boundaries lack documented clearances to ensure they maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductors. Site plan shows 5' Electric Easements on eastern boundary, but no section views or dimension annotations demonstrate that site features (buildings, utilities, structures) within or adjacent to these easements maintain required clearances.

Water meters' maintenance of minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor of existing overhead electric service drops cannot be verified. Water meter locations are not clearly identified on utility plans with dimension annotations from overhead service-drop conductor locations.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8, driveways, overhead electric facility locations
findings.comment: Survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is not provided. The existing survey shows overhead electric lines at the property edges, but proposed building finished floor elevations and driveway grades must be verified against mid-span overhead conductor elevations. Without registered surveyor documentation of conductor heights and mid-span clearance data, vertical clearances from buildings and driveways to overhead lines cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas near overhead electric lines on southern and eastern property boundaries
findings.comment: Proposed trees are not verified to be from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list per ECM Appendix F. The landscape plan proposes 10 Cedar Elm (mature height 40-50 ft) and 2 Live Oak (mature height 40-80 ft) as primary shade trees—both are large-canopy species that are NOT utility-compatible. Large mitigation trees (marked 'M') are shown adjacent to the southern property boundary where overhead electric lines are located; their species are not identified on the plan. There is no notation verifying that proposed trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution lines are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F.

Transformers' maintenance of minimum 7.5-foot vertical sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric lines cannot be verified. Sheet 21 shows transformer pad locations, but no section views document vertical clearance dimensions from overhead line conductors to top of transformer equipment.

Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines as required by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. While a pre-construction safety meeting requirement for transmission facilities is noted, no 48-hour notification requirement note for work near distribution line facilities is present on cover sheet or general notes.
